correctness.rationale: Independent stationary innovation series is absolutely summable and unique by Poisson jump contraction. Innovation is exactly an asymmetric Laplace difference of two exponentials. The stationary moment-generating domain follows from independent exponential rates; the sole competing slow negative terms have rates lambda_- and lambda_+/b. Single-exponential and double-exponential gamma convolution lemmas prove all three sharp density tails with positive finite product constants. Exact rational moment and pole checks (96 assertions) corroborate, rather than replace, the analytic infinite-tail proof.
